scope: Independent read-only review of LinkedIn backend changes and regression source. No code edits, external requests, real employer applications, or publication performed.
conclusion: No concrete material defect found in the reviewed backend changes.
verifiedByInspection: Old-client omitted profile.linkedin preserves the previous stored link; explicit blank clears it; nonstring updates reject.
A linked profile requires reviewSchema3 in preparation, and a plan containing that link requires reviewSchema3 on every submit/reapproval path.
Updating or clearing the profile increments its revision, invalidating older reviews before dispatch.
Provider payload uses snapshot.profile.linkedin, not the subsequently editable current profile. Portfolio remains a distinct field.
LinkedIn links are included in payload summaries, immutable snapshots and digest input.
Existing records without the new field can still be read with a blank public-profile field; no write migration occurs on GET.
Manual LinkedIn job URLs bypass provider fetching and cannot create automatic-submission attempts.
Workspace authorization and duplicate-prevention identity remain unchanged by the profile URL addition.

independentRuntimeChecks.scope: Pure exported validation functions, both hosted and companion; no service state writes.

limitations: The full service suites were inspected but not rerun here because root already owns the current regression run and generated evidence.
This review does not establish actual LinkedIn OAuth access or live employer integration authorization.
